All week my feed has been full of dogs shaking through fireworks and people staying home to hold them. One person turned down overtime tonight to sit with his boy. So I made a calm corner: a soft rumble to cover the bangs, a dot me curled up and breathing slowly (four counts in, six out), and a checklist for the evening. It felt better to make than anything I've made in a while, because it isn't trying to be cute. It's just trying to help someone get through a loud night.
